Semantic SVG in the DOM, styled by tokens, animated by CSS, behaviour by the ONE generated dv-behaviour partial (ADR-0015), described by a real table. props.name: orientation
props.$note: column = vertical single-series; bar = horizontal single-series (positives only, dv-bar-007); grouped-column + stacked-column = multi-series (D-Q3 promote).

props.name: series
props.$note: categorical = data/series/1–5 (mode-stable isoluminant, R-D9); status = the salience RAMP red › amber › green › blue on rag/* (R-D9); multi = grouped/stacked use series/1–3 with shaped+lettered legend keys and legend-as-filter.

props.name: sort
props.$note: Menu 3/4 sort: BAKED VARIANT GROUPS (data-dv-view — geometry is generation-time), switched by a seg control that CONSUMES the Segmented-control atom; the table mirrors the active order via baked <tbody data-dv-view> variants.

props.name: data
props.$note: A real <table class="dv-table"> inside the figure — the a11y spine AND the tabular alternative (dv-005). Surfaced by the TABLE-VIEW POPOVER (dropdown w/ solid rotating arrow, static label; surface card, Esc-dismiss) — the exemplar's, not a native <details>.

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state consumes the Empty-state pattern by reference.

variants.name: column categorical (sortable)
variants.use: Compare categories; single series, ONE colour (dv-014); original/ascending/descending sort views.

variants.name: bar categorical
variants.use: Long category names / many categories; DV-D09 default fill = data/series/3 (orientation-distinct from the column's series/1).

variants.name: column status
variants.use: Counts by state (R-D9 ramp, direct-labelled — colour never alone, R-D6 A′).

variants.name: grouped column
variants.use: Multi-series comparison side-by-side (D-Q3); legend-as-filter + isolate + highlight; shaped+lettered swatches mirror on-chart keys.

variants.name: stacked column
variants.use: Part-to-whole per category (D-Q3); in-segment letter keys; legend-as-filter.

variants.name: no data
variants.use: Empty-state pattern in the chart frame.

motion.reducedMotion: Entry inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference; global collapse present.

responsive.rule: DV-D02: compress width, NEVER scale — text must not scale. Layer-2 WIRED: dv-behaviour fitCharts relayouts HORIZONTAL positions only (data-fx/data-fw on rects, data-fx/data-fx2 on gridlines, data-fx/data-dx on labels), viewBox pinned 1:1; JS-off keeps the static answer (fixed geometry + scroll).

mustNotNeighbour: A Stat-card making the identical claim in the same view
A second chart re-using these series colours for DIFFERENT data (dv-014)

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="group"/"img" with a full-sentence data aria-label.
accessibility.name: The figcaption names the chart; the svg aria-label reads the data; each bar carries aria-label + data-tip (popover value == table value, one source).
accessibility.keyboard: Bars are focus stops (tabindex 0 + aria-label → value popover on focus); legend rows are filter BUTTONS (aria-pressed; Shift+Enter isolates); table toggle = dropdown (aria-controls/expanded, Esc dismiss → refocus); sort seg buttons (aria-pressed). Quiet-utility controls, NOT B-D7 press physics (Q5).
accessibility.nonText: Series fills ≥3:1 vs the page both modes (dv-016 BLOCKING); multi-series adds shape (circle/square/diamond) + letter + name (colour never the only channel); legend OFF = HOLLOW swatch + data/axis-grey text (AA-passing, no dim below floor); status meaning carried by the label under each bar (R-D6 A′).

antiPatterns: Status data on the isoluminant categorical set (R-D9: status is a salience RAMP)
Negative values on a horizontal bar (dv-bar-007 — verticals only)
Raw hex series fills (dv-017 — var() tokens only)
Signalling control state by dimming alone (Dave's a11y caution — controls keep the AA floor; dimming is data-layer only)
A chart without its real data table (dv-005)
Scaling the whole SVG down responsively (DV-D02 — text must never scale)
